# CausalEmergence

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where higher-level macro-states exhibit causal relationships not present at the micro-level, often arising from coarse-graining or architectural constraints. Central to designing hierarchical TCC topologies and iNEST spiking networks that can extract task-relevant causal structure from raw sensory streams.
